info.name: HopAlong — Frontend API
info.description:
📮 Postman collection for the **HopAlong frontend** — mirrors every call made by `frontend/src/api/api.js` through the Axios client (`frontend/src/api/client.js`).

Use this to test **exactly what the UI sends** to the backend, request-by-request, page-by-page.

| Frontend API object | Backend prefix | Used by UI |
|---|---|---|
| `authApi` | `/api/auth` | Login.jsx, Register.jsx, Header (logout), Profile (password) |
| `tripsApi` | `/api/trips` | Home (browse + filters), CreateTrip, TripDetail, Dashboard (stats) |
| `requestsApi` | `/api/requests` | TripDetail (RequestModal, RequestsList), Dashboard |
| `messagesApi` | `/api/messages` | TripDetail (ChatPanel) |
| `usersApi` | `/api/users` | Profile.jsx, Dashboard |

### 🚀 How to use
1. Start backend (`cd backend && npm run dev`) and frontend (`cd frontend && npm run dev`).
2. Run **authApi → Login** first — the test script auto-saves `token` and `userId` (same key `token` the app stores in `localStorage`).
3. Create/save a trip via **tripsApi → Create Trip** to auto-save `tripId`; send a request via **requestsApi → Send Request** to save `requestId`; send a chat message via **messagesApi → Send Message** to save `messageId`.
4. The Bearer token is applied automatically to protected requests — just like the Axios request interceptor does.

### 🔑 Demo credentials (after `cd backend && npm run seed`)
| Email | Password |
|---|---|
| `rahul.sharma@iitr.ac.in` | `password123` |
| `priya.patel@iitr.ac.in` | `password123` |

### 🧩 Mirror notes
- The frontend `client.js` interceptor attaches `Authorization: Bearer <token>` to every request and redirects to `/` on **401** — the same behavior is reproduced here.
- `requestsApi.sendRequest()` sends both `trip` and `tripId` keys; the backend controller reads `tripId`.
- Real-time chat updates come via Socket.IO (`frontend/src/api/socket.js`) and cannot be tested with REST requests.

item.name: authApi
item.description: Authentication calls — `frontend/src/api/api.js → authApi`. Used by Login.jsx, Register.jsx, Header (logout) and Profile (update password).

exec: console.log('Token saved (same as localStorage token key in the app)');

body.raw:
{
  "name": "New Student",
  "email": "new.student@iitr.ac.in",
  "password": "password123",
  "branch": "CSE",
  "year": "2nd Year",
  "bio": "Hi! I travel on weekends."
}

request.description:
`authApi.register(userData)` → `POST /auth/register`

Called by **Register.jsx** on form submit. Only `*.iitr.ac.in` emails are accepted. On success the app stores the token in `localStorage` (`setAuthToken`) and logs the user in.

**Errors:** 400 validation / user exists.

exec: console.log('Token saved — protected requests in this collection will now pass');

request.description:
`authApi.login(email, password)` → `POST /auth/login`

Called by **Login.jsx**. On 401 the app clears the token and redirects to `/` (same rule the collection's 401 responses will show). **Run this first** to populate `token` + `userId`.

`authApi.getCurrentUser()` → `GET /auth/me`

Called on app bootstrap / refresh to restore the logged-in session from the stored token (ProtectedRoute + Zustand rehydrate).

`authApi.updatePassword(currentPassword, newPassword)` → `PUT /auth/updatepassword`

Called from the Profile page settings. New password must be ≥ 6 characters.

`authApi.logout()` → `POST /auth/logout`

Called from the Header logout button. The app then removes the auth token from `localStorage` and redirects to `/`.

item.name: tripsApi
item.description: Trip calls — `frontend/src/api/api.js → tripsApi`. Used by Home.jsx (browse + FiltersBar), CreateTrip.jsx, TripDetail.jsx and Dashboard.jsx (stats).

request.description:
`tripsApi.getTrips(filters)` → `GET /trips?...`

Called by **Home.jsx** on load and every time the user applies **FiltersBar** or uses the search box. All filters map 1:1 to the URL params built in `api.js`.

`tripsApi.getTrip(id)` → `GET /trips/:id`

Called by **TripDetail.jsx** to render trip info, organizer, participants, requests (for organizer) and the chat panel.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Weekend Trip to Rishikesh",
  "description": "River rafting, camping and bonfire by the Ganga.",
  "destination": "Rishikesh",
  "startDate": "2026-11-20",
  "endDate": "2026-11-22",
  "maxParticipants": 6,
  "estimatedCost": 2500,
  "mode": "Bus",
  "type": "Adventure"
}

request.description:
`tripsApi.createTrip(tripData)` → `POST /trips`

Called by **CreateTrip.jsx** (TripForm submit). Organizer is taken from the JWT — the same user becomes participant #1.

`tripsApi.updateTrip(id, updates)` → `PUT /trips/:id`

Called by the Edit form in **TripDetail.jsx** — only visible to the trip organizer. Partial updates are supported (send only changed fields).

`tripsApi.deleteTrip(id)` → `DELETE /trips/:id`

Called by the Delete button in **TripDetail.jsx** (organizer only, confirmation dialog first). ⚠️ Destructive — run last.

`tripsApi.getUserTrips(userId)` → `GET /trips/user/:userId`

Called by **Profile.jsx** to list trips organized by the user.

`tripsApi.getTripStats()` → `GET /trips/stats`

Called by **Dashboard.jsx** to show trip statistics cards.

item.name: requestsApi
item.description: Join-request calls — `frontend/src/api/api.js → requestsApi`. Used by TripDetail.jsx (RequestModal, RequestsList) and Dashboard.jsx (my requests).

request.description:
`requestsApi.sendRequest(tripId, message)` → `POST /requests`

Called by **RequestModal.jsx** from a trip detail page. Note: `api.js` sends both `trip` and `tripId`; the backend reads `tripId`. The organizer is notified live via Socket.IO `request:notification`.

**Errors:** 400 (duplicate, trip full, own trip), 404 trip not found.

`requestsApi.getRequestsForTrip(tripId)` → `GET /requests/trip/:tripId`

Called by **RequestsList.jsx** inside TripDetail (organizer view) to review pending/approved/rejected requests.

`requestsApi.getUserRequests(userId)` → `GET /requests/user/:userId`

Called by **Dashboard.jsx** to show the requests you have sent and their statuses.

`requestsApi.approveRequest(requestId)` → `PUT /requests/:id/approve`

Called by the ✅ Approve button in **RequestsList.jsx** (organizer only). Adds the requester to participants, bumps seat count, and fires `request:status-update` over Socket.IO.

`requestsApi.rejectRequest(requestId)` → `PUT /requests/:id/reject`

Called by the ❌ Reject button in **RequestsList.jsx** (organizer only).

`requestsApi.cancelRequest(requestId)` → `DELETE /requests/:id`

Called by the Cancel button next to your own pending request (sender only).

item.name: messagesApi
item.description: Chat calls — `frontend/src/api/api.js → messagesApi`. Used by TripDetail.jsx (ChatPanel). Real-time delivery uses Socket.IO on top of these REST calls.

request.description:
`messagesApi.getMessages(tripId)` → `GET /messages/trip/:tripId`

Called by **ChatPanel.jsx** when a trip is opened — loads chat history sorted oldest → newest. Returns `{ success, count, data }`; responds `[]` instead of an error when there are no messages. Cached 60s (`Cache-Control`).

`messagesApi.sendMessage(tripId, content)` → `POST /messages`

Called by the ChatPanel input. Body uses `trip` + `content` (matches `api.js`). Live broadcast to other participants happens via Socket.IO `message:new` in the `trip:{id}` room.

`messagesApi.deleteMessage(messageId)` → `DELETE /messages/:id`

Called by the delete option on your own chat bubbles (sender only).

item.name: usersApi
item.description: User profile calls — `frontend/src/api/api.js → usersApi`. Used by Profile.jsx and Dashboard.jsx.

request.description:
`usersApi.getUser(userId)` → `GET /users/:id`

Called by **Profile.jsx** (route `/profile/:id`) to render a user's public profile.

`usersApi.updateUser(userId, updates)` → `PUT /users/:id`

Called by the Edit Profile form — only for your own profile. Updatable fields: `name`, `branch`, `year`, `bio`.

`usersApi.getUserTrips(userId)` → `GET /users/:id/trips`

Called by **Profile.jsx** — trips organized by this user.

`usersApi.getUserParticipations(userId)` → `GET /users/:id/participations`

Called by **Profile.jsx** — trips this user has joined as a participant.

`usersApi.getUserStats(userId)` → `GET /users/:id/stats`

Called by **Dashboard.jsx** — stats cards (trips created, trips joined).
